name: consumer-package-only
description: A declared consumer that holds no compiler configuration is loaded through the programs formed for its JavaScript files, each resolving its modules as the runtime its own package is written for: a consumer a bundler's convention row applies to resolves an extensionless relative import as the bundler does, so the target declaration it names is live. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named vite for the package vite, holding the installed version in its range.
